CORAM:
 HON'BLE MS. JUSTICE REKHA PALLI  ORDER  % 23.03.2023  CM APPL. 14156/2023 -Ex.
1.
Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.
CM APPL. 14158/2023 (delay 23 days)
3. This is an application filed by the appellant seeking condonation of 23 days' delay in filing the appeal.
4. The application is, for the reasons stated therein, allowed and the delay of 23 days in filing the appeal is condoned.
5. The application stands disposed of.

6. The present appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act preferred by the insurer of the Tata Ace Tempo bearing registration no. DL-1LM-2968 assails the award dated 07.11.2022 passed Reliance General Insurance Co Ltd vs Sh Satyapal Singh & Ors on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186695638/
1 by the learned MACT.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 7. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the learned Tribunal has failed to appreciate the fact that the policy in respect of the offending vehicle already stood cancelled on account of non-payment of premium and therefore, no liability could have been fastened on the appellant.

Furthermore, once the owner of the offending vehicle i.e. respondent no. 7 had clearly admitted during his cross examination that the offending vehicle was not insured with the appellant at the time of accident, the appellant could not be liable to pay part of the compensation.
8. Issue notice.

Mr. Jain accepts notice for respondent nos.1 to 5.
9.
Upon the appellant taking steps, issue notice to respondent nos. 6 to 9 through all permissible modes.
11.In the meanwhile, let the LCR be requisitioned and digitized before the next date.

CM APPL. 14157/2023 -Stay.
12.This is an application preferred by the appellant seeking stay of the impugned award.

Taking into account that the claimants cannot be made to suffer during the pendency of the present appeal,
which is primarily directed against the respondent nos.6 to 9, no ground is made out for staying the impugned award.

It is, however, made clear that payment of the awarded amount in terms of the impugned award by the appellant to respondent nos. 1 to 5 would remain subject to outcome of the present appeal and, therefore, the appellant would be entitled to recover the same from the other respondents, if this Court were to allow the appeal.
13.The application is, accordingly, dismissed.
REKHA PALLI, J MARCH 23, 2023 acm
